create_sparsefuncs_mean_variance_axis: compute mean and variance along an axis on a CSR or CSC sparse matrix with optional sample weights
create_sparsefuncs_inplace_column_scale: scale each feature column of a CSR or CSC sparse matrix in-place by a given scale array
create_sparsefuncs_inplace_row_scale: scale each sample row of a CSR or CSC sparse matrix in-place by a given scale array
create_sparsefuncs_inplace_swap_row: swap two rows of a CSR or CSC sparse matrix in-place by index
create_sparsefuncs_sparse_matmul_to_dens: compute sparse matrix multiplication of two CSR/CSC matrices and return a dense numpy array
